exposure: Selective screening based on different European guidelines
Universal screening with a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
Risk factors for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
selective screening for gestational diabetes mellitus
outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of different screening guidelines
cohort: 1811 women who received universal screening for gestational diabetes mellitus with a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test
finding: Selective screening for gestational diabetes mellitus using European guidelines would result in a significant proportion of women requiring an OGTT, with the Dutch guidelines missing the fewest cases but still necessitating an OGTT for 50% of the women.
mod_finding: GDM women without risk factors had less cesarean sections than GDM women with risk factors.
